_why: The base every candidate is measured against, per Mac tier: the stock Ollama library build of the base each published Grux Local tag was trained from (results/v1.json base_model and before_training_model). A candidate competes in the tier its size puts it in (common.tier_for).
since_why: S1 measured the whole open field on ollama.com on 2026-10-22 (Grux-Mac docs/factory/local-model-eval.md) and the Qwen 3.5 base was chosen from it; a base published or re-published after that date is new.

license_allowlist.apache-2.0: permits redistributing modified weights with the license and notices kept
license_allowlist.mit: permits redistributing modified weights with the notice kept

license_overrides_why: Key '<source>:<id>' to {license, reason}. Anything not on the allowlist stays out unless it is named here with the reason it is safe to ship fine-tuned weights under it.

train.recipe: 4b-v2: LoRA rank 64, two epochs, round 2 data
train.data_path_why: Pinned by install_launchd.py --train-data, which scans the source and drops rows with an identity term (and refuses a secret shape) on the way in; GRUX_LOCAL_TRAIN_DATA overrides it.
train.data_scan_vocab_why: Identity terms for s2/data_scan.py, kept outside this public repo: Grux's own banned vocabulary plus a local list.
